title: 30-Day Job-Switch Roadmap
intendedUser: Working professional with 1-5 years experience seeking a job switch
description: A practical 30-day roadmap for working professionals to organise their job-switching process.

activities: Set up job alerts on portals
measurableTasks: Resume reviewed by peer or mentor

activities: Reach out to 3 connections for referrals
measurableTasks: 5+ applications submitted with tailored cover letters
Application tracker populated with first 5 entries

activities: Prepare STAR-format stories from recent experience
Send thank-you messages after each interview
Reflect on learnings and adjust strategy

milestones: Day 1-7: Profile optimisation and initial applications submitted
Day 8-14: Interview preparation and skills practice
Day 22-30: Reflection, strategy adjustment, and sustained momentum
